description: List of the available pivot fields shown in the pivot-table field panel. Each field has an actions menu to add it to the Row, Column, Value, or Filter area, and fields already in use are marked with an area badge.

parameters.name: ColumnFieldKeys
parameters.description: Keys of fields currently in the row area.

parameters.name: DataFieldKeys
parameters.description: Keys of fields currently in the column area.

parameters.name: FilterFields
parameters.description: Keys of fields currently in the data area.

parameters.name: OnAddToArea
parameters.description: Keys of fields currently in the filter area.

parameters.name: OnRemove
parameters.description: Fires when a field should be added/moved to a target area.
